cards.audioText: You are at the holding point of runway 04. Call Wuhan Tower, you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在跑道04的等待点。呼叫武汉塔台，你已准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL162, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航162，准备好起飞。

cards.audioText: UAL162, Wuhan Tower, behind China Southern B777 on short final, then line up runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，武汉塔台，跟在短五边南航波音777落地后进跑道04等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Behind China Southern B777 on short final, then line up runway 04, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟短五边南航波音777落地后进跑道04等待，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, when airborne turn right heading 070 climb and maintain 3000m. Cleared for immediate take-off runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，离地后右转航向070，上升保持3000米。可以立刻起飞，跑道04。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: When airborne turn right heading 070 climb and maintain 3000m. Cleared for immediate take-off runway 04, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向070，上升保持3000米。可以立刻起飞，跑道04，美联航162。

cards.audioText: Now you are airborne, and passing 1200m, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机已经离地，飞过1200米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL162, airborne runway 04, passing 1200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航162，跑道04起飞，通过1200米。

cards.audioText: UAL162, after passing 1200m, turn left direct to ZF.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，通过1200米后左转直飞ZF。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200m, turn left direct to ZF, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过1200米后左转直飞ZF，美联航162。

cards.audioText: After 9 hours flight. Now you are in London control area, maintaining FL350. You have encountered volcanic ash. Tell controller the situation and request descent. Call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行9个小时后，你到了伦敦管制区，高度层350保持。你遇到了火山灰，告诉管制员该情况并请求下降。呼叫伦敦区调。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL162, maintaining FL350, we have encountered volcanic ash, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦区调，美联航162，高度层350保持，我们遇到了火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: UAL162, turn right heading 300, descend and maintain FL290.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，右转航向300，下降保持高度层290。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 300, descend and maintain FL290, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，下降保持高度层290，美联航162。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC, you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉ATC，你仍在火山灰区域，发动机震动剧烈，但飞机仍能控制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL162, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly but aircraft can be still controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦区调，美联航162，我们还在火山灰区域内，发动机震动剧烈，但飞机仍能控制。

cards.audioText: During descent, both engines flamed out. Make a distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降时，发动机全部熄火。做一个遇险呼叫并请求在最近的机场降落。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. London Control, UAL162. Both engines flame out. Request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY。伦敦区调，美联航162。双发熄火，请求降落在最近的机场。

cards.audioText: UAL162, London Control, roger MAYDAY. Turn right heading 340.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，伦敦区调，收到MAYDAY。右转航向340。【复诵】

cards.audioText: One engine was successfully restarted during descent. Tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降时，一侧发动机成功重新起动。告诉ATC这一情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL162, one engine was successfully restarted.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦区调，美联航162，一侧发动机起动成功。

cards.audioText: UAL162, report intention.[Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，报告意图。【告诉ATC你仍需要降落在最近的机场，因为重启的发动机运行不稳定。】
cards.referenceText: We still need to land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于重启的发动机运行不稳定，我们仍需降落在最近的机场，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, continue descend and maintain 9000 feet on QNH 1021, expect to land at Beatle airport.[Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle airport. Request airport information.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，继续下降保持修正海压9000英尺，修正海压1021，预计降落在Beatle机场。【告诉管制员你不熟悉该机场。请求提供机场信息。】
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 9000 feet QNH 1021, request airport information, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降保持修正海压9000英尺，修正海压1021，请求提供机场信息，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, Beatle airport landing runway 02, elevation 2000ft, runway 3000m long, 45m wide, ILS CAT I and II available.[Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，Beatle机场使用着陆跑道02，标高2000英尺，跑道长3000米，宽45米，支持一类、二类盲降。【告诉ATC你能降落在这个机场。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, we can land at this airport, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们能够降落在这个机场，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, continue descend and maintain 5000 feet and contact Beatle Approach 121.3.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，继续下降保持5000英尺，联系Beatle机场进近121.3。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 5000 feet and contact Beatle Approach 121.3, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降保持5000英尺，联系Beatle机场进近121.3，美联航162。

cards.audioText: Contact Beatle Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系该机场进近，告诉他们你的紧急状况。
cards.referenceText: Beatle Approach, UAL162, we have one engine failure, request emergency land.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beatle进近，美联航162，机上一发失效，请求紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL162, Beatle Approach, roger, runway is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.[Tell ATC you can see the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，Beatle进近，收到，跑道在你2点钟方向，距离10海里，能见跑道报告。【告诉ATC你能看到跑道。】

cards.audioText: Tell Approach, you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉进近，跑道附近需要准备好紧急服务。
cards.referenceText: Beatle Approach, UAL162, we need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beatle进近，美联航162，跑道附近需要准备好紧急服务。
